title: Advantech ADAM-5017UH 8-Channel Analog Input Module
description: Thing Model for the Advantech ADAM-5017UH eight-channel analog input module. It describes eight read-only Modbus input-register values as raw 16-bit words. The register mapping is derived from the ADAM-5000L/TCP manual and assumes the documented slot word offset; verify rack, slot, firmware, channel range and wire format for the installation. No engineering-unit conversion or hardware validation is claimed.
